create_SiglipVisionModel: create a SiglipVisionModel instance with SiglipVisionConfig for image embedding inference
build_SiglipVisionTransformer: build a SiglipVisionTransformer that converts pixel values to last hidden state embeddings
create_SiglipEncoder: create a SiglipEncoder with configurable hidden layers and optional quantization config
create_SiglipEncoderLayer: create a SiglipEncoderLayer with vision attention and MLP using layer normalization
create_SiglipMLP: create a SiglipMLP with column-parallel and row-parallel linear layers and QuickGELU activation
